title: La Voz: la canción grabada de Marta
description: docs/quests/marta.md § Final boss. La Voz sings Marta's own recording in a loop (public/music/marta-voz.m4a), and every note she sings is a move of hers: a beam of its colour at whom she sings that turn at (the chip «Canta → …»), with its element. She is only hurt in her silences, solid then; while a note sounds she is light. Her status ring is the turn of the phrase she is on, lit on a note and dark in a silence. Fight tester: Gerard in Matemágico, Aitor in Papagato, free maná, no PV lost. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.ready = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.phase === 'player' && !ui.fight.busy && !document.querySelector('#battle[data-entering]') && document.activeElement?.matches('.command-trigger'); window.song = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.song; window.cmd = id => document.querySelector('[data-command="' + id + '"] .command-trigger').click(); window.sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); window.round = async (id, what = 'attack') => { for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) { while (!ready()) await sleep(100); cmd(what); await sleep(450); document.querySelector('.battle-target[data-target="' + id + '"]')?.click(); await sleep(500); } }; const st = document.createElement('style'); st.textContent = '.shot-frozen * { animation-play-state: paused !important; }'; document.head.append(st); window.frozen = ''; window.catchNote = (test, after = 120) => { window.frozen = ''; const o = new MutationObserver(() => { const hit = [...document.querySelectorAll('.damage-pop small, .damage-pop strong')].find(el => test(el.textContent)); if (hit) { o.disconnect(); setTimeout(() => { window.gerard.game.app.timeScale = 0; document.documentElement.classList.add('shot-frozen'); window.frozen = hit.textContent; }, after); } }); o.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true }); }; window.thaw = () => { window.gerard.game.app.timeScale = 1; document.documentElement.classList.remove('shot-frozen'); window.frozen = ''; };

steps.caption: Her first note, Do: while a note sounds she is light of its colour and see-through, and a blow goes through her. The chip says whom she sings this turn at; the ring is the turn of her phrase, in the rhythm she sang it

steps.eval: thaw(); window.frozen = ''; (function look() { if (window.song() === 'Silencio') { window.ts ??= performance.now(); if (performance.now() - window.ts > 150) { window.gerard.game.app.timeScale = 0; document.documentElement.classList.add('shot-frozen'); window.frozen = 'Silencio'; return; } } else window.ts = undefined; requestAnimationFrame(look); })(); 0

steps.caption: A silence: she is solid, the only moment a blow finds her
Sol: a beam of water at whom she sings at, and it wets
Fa right after: a bolt, jagged like lightning; on someone wet it runs through the water (Conducción) and may leave them in shock
Re: the heaviest of her notes, a physical blow
Si♭: fire, and it burns (again while it burns, a level up)
La, the note everyone tunes to: it reaches the whole party
Both holding on: each note lands at a third on a small white ring, and leaves no water and no fire. Against her song, holding on lasts until that one acts again
Picker moment «Andante, donde canta deprisa»: the fast turns of her phrase, notes bound one into the next and almost no silence: a time to hold on
